name: @ecodev/natural-gallery-js
description: Stub that exposes the upstream build in ./checkout/dist as a package. Committed on purpose: pnpm resolves local dependencies before it runs the root preinstall, so this file must exist before ../scripts/build-upstream.mjs has had a chance to run. The root depends on it through `link:`, which symlinks the folder as-is — with `file:` pnpm packs it during resolution, i.e. before checkout/dist exists. The version is static to keep lockfiles stable, the real one is in checkout/dist/package.json.
